content: 1. The study titled LTH Clinics in Papua New Guinea: A Cross-Sectional Study was published in BMJ Open, Volume 7, Issue 12, with the article identifier e018630. 2. Zemouri C, Wi TE, Kiarie J, Seuc A, Mogasale V, Latif A, and Broutet N conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of syndromic management of vaginal discharge in treating vaginal and cervical infections. Their findings were published in PLoS One on October 5, 2016, in Volume 11, Issue 10, with the article identifier e0163365.
